about: Every Life Hub control Shika can use (16 Nov 2026, Georgi: 'control every single little feature on the life hub with Shika'). One entry = one control. route: money (money token), heat, time, lights (sync token). fixed: params always sent; '{name}' is replaced by a param, a whole '{name}' keeps the param's type. json: fixed params sent as JSON text. dry: params that turn the call into a preview (sent instead of the same fixed ones). level: read (runs, returns data), now (small and easy to undo: runs at once, Shika says what he did), ask (shown first, runs after his yes: deleting, money, invoices, anything sent to someone). A new control = one entry here. Check: node actions-check.js

actions.name: heat.home
actions.what: Heating: I am home (living room back on its schedule).

actions.name: heat.away
actions.what: Heating: I am away (living room off).

actions.name: heat.sammy
actions.what: Sammy is home today (kids room warm 08:00-17:15). on: 1 or 0.

actions.name: heat.sammy_away
actions.what: Sammy away (kids room off round the clock until turned off). on: 1 or 0.

actions.name: heat.keep_on
actions.what: Keep the living room on even when away, until 23:00. on: 1 or 0.

actions.name: heat.set
actions.what: Set one room until its next schedule change. room: living or bed (kids room). temp: 5-30 in 0.5 steps, off, or auto (back to the schedule).

actions.name: heat.holiday
actions.what: Holiday: everything off until 3 h before the return. until: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM (Sofia time) or off.

actions.name: heat.price
actions.what: Electricity prices in EUR per kWh with VAT.

actions.name: lights.report
actions.what: Living-room lights fault report, now. kind: off-present (turned off while I was there), off-dark (off while dark), on-bright (on when bright), no-on (did not come on), ghost (on with nobody there).

actions.name: lights.unreport
actions.what: Take back a fault report. at: its time in ms.

actions.name: lights.limits
actions.what: Lux limits: lights on below `on`, off above `off` (off at least on + 1, 1-5000).

actions.name: time.list
actions.what: Time page data: marks, visits, places, runs.

actions.name: time.mark
actions.what: Mark now. mark: ready (getting ready, what = the trip), out (left home), back (home), in / off (arrived at / left a place: place needed), start / stop (a timer at home: what needed for start).

params.mark: ready | out | back | in | off | start | stop

actions.name: time.add
actions.what: Add a finished trip or task by hand. start, end: ms.

actions.name: time.edit
actions.what: Change a mark's time (at) or end (ms), or its name.

actions.name: time.delete
actions.what: Delete marks (ids, comma separated).

actions.name: time.name_place
actions.what: Name the place at lat/lon (empty name removes it). Existing names are reused.

actions.name: training.done
actions.what: Tick a session done. key: from lifehub training (w3-0-0).

actions.name: training.undone
actions.what: Untick a session.

actions.name: training.move
actions.what: Move a session to a date.

actions.name: training.skip
actions.what: Skip a session. reason: Ill or injured, Life got in the way, Other.

actions.name: training.restore
actions.what: Undo a move and a skip: the session goes back to its planned day.

actions.name: training.change
actions.what: Several moves and skips at once, e.g. a coach card's ops: {moves: {key: YYYY-MM-DD or null}, skips: {key: reason or null}, checks: {key: true or null}}.

actions.name: training.log
actions.what: A session's log (time, effort, kg per exercise...). value: the fields to set, e.g. {"rpe": 7, "w": {"deadlift": 60}}.

actions.name: biz.read
actions.what: Business data: invoices, bookings, clients, job clock (large).

actions.name: biz.book
actions.what: Add a booking. shoot: YYYY-MM-DD; amounts in EUR (records only, never added to a total).

actions.name: biz.edit_booking
actions.what: Change any fields of a booking (only the ones sent).

actions.name: biz.delivered
actions.what: Mark a booking delivered on a date (empty clears).

actions.name: biz.paid_cash
actions.what: Mark a booking paid in cash on a date (empty clears).

actions.name: biz.delete_booking
actions.what: Delete a booking (its timed sessions stay).

actions.name: biz.clock_start
actions.what: Start the job clock (stops any running one). phase: shoot or edit.

actions.name: biz.clock_stop
actions.what: Stop the job clock.

actions.name: biz.time_add
actions.what: Add job time by hand. start, end: ms.

actions.name: biz.time_edit
actions.what: Change a timed session.

actions.name: biz.time_delete
actions.what: Delete a timed session.

actions.name: biz.client
actions.what: A client's contact (name exactly as on the invoices; only fields sent change).

actions.name: biz.invoice_type
actions.what: Type of shoot on an invoice.

actions.name: biz.invoice_note
actions.what: Private note on an invoice.

actions.name: biz.invoice_cancel
actions.what: Cancel an invoice (number stays used; v empty undoes).

actions.name: inv.next
actions.what: Next invoice number, known clients, invoices issued here.

actions.name: inv.issue
actions.what: Issue an invoice (PDF to the accountant's Drive). d: {client: {name, eik, vat, city, address, mol}, lines: [{name, qty, price, unit}], date, priceMode: gross|net, vatRate: 20|9|0, bank, payment, expectNo}. The preview shows the totals and words.

actions.name: inv.mail
actions.what: The email to send with an invoice: address, subject, text.

actions.name: inv.send
actions.what: Email an issued invoice with its PDF from Georgi's Gmail. Read inv.mail first.

actions.name: money.category
actions.what: Set a bank row's category by hand (empty gives it back to the rules). k: the row key.

actions.name: money.categories
actions.what: Every category in use.

actions.name: money.pending_add
actions.what: A card payment not booked yet (dropped by itself when the bank books it).

actions.name: money.pending_delete
actions.what: Remove a hand-added pending payment.

actions.name: money.check_now
actions.what: Read the banks now (the bank caps reads a day: not more than about twice).

actions.name: money.statements
actions.what: File new company bank statements from Gmail to the accountant's Drive.

actions.name: jar.add
actions.what: A new idea. value: {t: text, area: QA work | Life | Photography | Side projects, s: new}.

actions.name: jar.set
actions.what: Change an idea (text, area, or state s: new | review | acted | discarded).

actions.name: robotics.add
actions.what: Add to robotics. list: projects {name, s, next, notes, links, need} | parts {name, qty, due, where, note, link} | lessons {t, s, project, link}.

actions.name: robotics.set
actions.what: Change a robotics project, part or lesson.

actions.name: robotics.delete
actions.what: Delete a robotics project, part or lesson.

actions.name: promo.add
actions.what: A promo code. value: {vendor, code, exp: YYYY-MM-DD, note}.

actions.name: promo.set
actions.what: Change a promo code.

actions.name: promo.delete
actions.what: Delete a promo code.

actions.name: car.log
actions.what: A car log entry. car: swift | alfa. value: {d: YYYY-MM-DD, km, items: [what was done]}.

actions.name: meals.cart
actions.what: Tick a shopping item bought (true) or not (false). id: the item key from lifehub meals.

actions.name: meals.need
actions.what: Mark a pantry item needed (true) or had (false).

actions.name: holidays.trip
actions.what: Add or change a trip (fields like dest, from, to, who; a new id adds one).

actions.name: holidays.trip_delete
actions.what: Delete a trip.

actions.name: holidays.social
actions.what: A people plan (friends, date night...) by id: fields like status, time.

actions.name: doc.edit
actions.what: Anything else in a page's saved data: key (lifehub-jar, -robotics, -promo, -car, -meals, -holidays, season-2027-gl, budget), path (dot path to a list or map), op add | set | del, id, value. Read the data first; the preview shows before and after.
